Question: fda approval for covid vaccine

Answer: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the following COVID-19 vaccines::
- Pfizer-BioNTech: December 11, 2020 (Emergency Use Authorization [EUA]) and May 23, 2021 (Full Approval)
- Moderna: December 18, 2020 (EUA) and December 19, 2021 (Full Approval)
- Novavax: June 21, 2022 (EUA) and December 19, 2022 (Full Approval)
- Johnson & Johnson: February 27, 2021 (EUA) and March 5, 2021 (Full Approval)
The FDA also authorized the use of updated versions of the vaccines to target emerging variants of the virus. The most recent update was authorized in June 2024 for the KP.2 variant.
It's important to note that the FDA approval process is rigorous and involves extensive review of safety and efficacy data. However, ongoing monitoring of the vaccines is crucial, and any new safety concerns will be addressed promptly.
